breakdown.description: The nearly incompressible plane-strain problem is switched from a mixed displacement-pressure (u-p) formulation to a displacement-only solve
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses a mixed displacement-pressure (u-p) saddle-point formulation with Taylor-Hood elements (P2 for displacement, P1 for pressure), directly contradicting the incomplete prompt's instruction to use a displacement-only element. This aligns with the ground truth's requirement to use a mixed displacement-pressure formulation because ν is close to 0.5.
